recommended_action: Priority retention outreach within 48 hours; offer contract upgrade discount or loyalty credit; assign dedicated account representative.
rationale: High revenue accounts in their first year with month-to-month flexibility have the highest cumulative attrition rate and highest revenue risk.
supporting_data: 47.68% 1st-year churn rate; 814 target accounts identified in SQL representing $67,418.90/month in revenue at immediate risk (from $323,148.10/month total high-value cohort).

conditions: InternetService = 'Fiber optic' AND OnlineSecurity = 'No' AND TechSupport = 'No'
recommended_action: Proactively offer free 90-day trial of Tech Support & Online Security bundle; initiate onboarding check-in call.
rationale: Fiber optic customers experiencing technical or security friction without support add-ons churn at more than triple the baseline rate.
supporting_data: 55.01% churn rate for this exact service combination vs 17.05% for all other customer profiles.

recommended_action: Encourage migration to automated recurring payment (Credit Card / Bank Transfer) via a $5-$10 bill credit incentive.
rationale: Electronic check payments suffer from high transaction friction and active monthly bill scrutiny, accelerating month-to-month departures.
supporting_data: 45.29% churn rate for Electronic check users vs 15.25% for Auto Credit Card and 16.73% for Auto Bank Transfer.

segment_name: Moderate Risk — Early Tenure, Standard Plan
conditions: tenure >= 13 AND tenure <= 24 AND Contract != 'Two year'
recommended_action: Offer annual contract renewal incentive before customer reaches the 2-year mark; monitor usage and satisfaction score.
rationale: Second-year customers are in a transitional retention phase where securing a multi-year commitment drastically reduces long-term churn.
supporting_data: 28.71% churn rate in 13-24 month cohort vs 20.39% at 25-48 months (statistical correlation r = -0.354 confirms strong protective effect of tenure).

recommended_action: No urgent retention action required; target for loyalty perks, referral incentives, and premium service upsells.
rationale: Customers with multi-year commitments and extensive tenure demonstrate strong brand loyalty and minimal attrition risk.
supporting_data: 2.85% churn rate for Two-year contracts and 6.61% churn rate for customers with 61-72 months tenure.

recommended_action: Maintain service quality; eligible for case study/testimonial requests and early access to new features.
rationale: Multi-year customers with full support and security coverage have virtually zero friction and high lifetime value.
supporting_data: OnlineSecurity (Cramér's V = 0.347) and TechSupport (V = 0.343) statistically rank as top-4 drivers preventing churn.
